guide_observations.finding: Shoot - Aww Made You Look revision689561; footer October4 2023, opinion guide. Current retail BiS unknown. Node365 explicitly retired and names this replacement.

Six separate nine-item grids; category icons are placeholders, including ranged weapon in Gastraphetes section. F0/F1/F2 denote absent Flurry/FlurryI/FlurryII. Source numbers/caps are unverified claims, not candidate totals.

Source preamble assumes maximum Unity and JSE-neck augments. Nexus base checkpoints exclude these magnitudes; exact paths and cape parts are selected separately. Nyame path B chosen by Nexus, rank unspecified.
Melee TP, Evisceration and Misc Sets headings contain no compositions. Common DT/Refresh idle and supported melee variants are separately authored Nexus assemblies, not transcribed source sets.

Namas & Apex heading contains only Namas grids. Jishnu uncapped STR/WSD differs from DEX/Crit alternate; Coronach NQ AGI differs from HQ STR. Preserve each observation. Conditional Orpheus/Hachirin/weather ring and ranked True Shot swaps are unclaimed.

Selected bullets, bolts and arrows are expendable. No rare stat-ammo shot, Unlimited Shot guarantee, capped Recycle, replenishment sufficiency or runtime guard is claimed. Base stages with Dispense are distinct from augmented stages that move Dispense to separate waist quivers/pouches. Changing ranged/main/sub weapons needs TP-loss and aftermath review.

Double Shot773759 uses extra ammo and does not apply to WS; shares recast with Unlimited Shot752272. Barrage764379 overwrites/is overwritten by Unlimited Shot. Equipment eligibility does not prove active buffs. Barrage+Double Shot interactions not operationally validated.

Alluvion Skirmish Armor Taeon Leaf and Dusk categories each provide Snapshot1-5. Source Snapshot10 is two5 parts, not one10. Existing strict matcher preserves multiplicity; requirement tested against fictional copies before save.

Oshosi pieces require Su3 (500 job points); base Amini earring right ear only, no random augment magnitude. Source Begrudging Ring Tonberry Grudge conditional effect not quantified. Sroda alter-ego attack not credited. RNG melee uses Velocity Shot off; ranged contexts may use it, no percentage total credited.
